feature: P6.7 caption spacing for an existing owned HWPX picture caption
previousLimitation: The properties panel could change only the Top/Bottom caption placement.
supported: Use the existing picture caption owner and verified rich caption snapshot. The panel accepts 0–327.67pt in 0.01pt increments; the engine stores a nonnegative signed-16-bit HWPUNIT gap. It checks the new gap and all retained properties before committing history.
refused: Missing or unrelated caption, locked or non-body owner, unproven atno and formatting, absent or out-of-range current gap, negative or fractional HWPUNIT, unchanged gap, unsupported caption placement, and HWP5 or DOCX.
